mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase above 8.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%, or Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, triggering equity sell-offs as corporate revenue expectations fall, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >1.5% MoM, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial production declines below 95.0 index points, manufacturing sector weakness reduces corporate profit margins and equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 95.0, or Rank IC for INDPRO < 95.0 is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate increase above 3.5% signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained employment growth above 150,000 monthly additions supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when PAYEMS growth exceeds 150,000, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and increases in inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal stagflation, reducing corporate profit margins and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines and CPIAUCSL rises, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts increase above 750,000 units signals strong consumer confidence and spending, boosting corporate revenue expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when HOUST exceeds 750.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
